caption_L1: Iran : National debt from 2014 to 2024 (in billion U.S. dollars) is a bar plot. The y-axis plots Year while the x-axis plots National debt in billion U.S. dollars.
caption_L2L3: Between 2014 and 2015 the debt tripled in that one year. 2017 was the only year that the debt reduced slightly. The debt was relatively stable until 2018 after which time it has grown at a faster rate year on year. The debt is projected to rise at an even greater rate by 2024.
